blockers.description: Wave 1 (01-01) is an irreversible production wipe: it drops pages/users/events/accounts/sessions in live MongoDB Atlas and deletes every object in the live S3 bucket, destroying the owner's own page. RESEARCH.md predicts the first run exits AccessDenied until s3:ListBucket and s3:DeleteObject are added to the S3_ACCESS_KEY IAM policy.
blockers.workaround: 01-01 Task 3 is a checkpoint:human-verify gate — an executor writes and commits the script but hands the actual run back to the user. The user must run it themselves against live infrastructure and type "approved".
